name: Quick & Crash
summary: "Quick Crash" is a novelty shooting gallery that tests player accuracy and reflexes to the limit. It's a throwback to the mechanical shooting games of the past with a few futuristic twists. The game keeps detailed records so players can see how they rank against the previous players and continue to track their current ranking. Since players have limited shots and are competing for the best possible time, accuracy and judgment are the most important talents to be successful in Quick Crash!
